Smoky Chickpea Skillet

Yield: 3 servings

Ingredients
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 1 onion
- 3 cloves garlic
- 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
- 1 teaspoon ground cumin
- 1 can (15 ounces) chickpeas
- 1 cup vegetable broth
- 2 cups baby spinach
- 2 tablespoons butter
- Salt and black pepper, to taste

Preparation
1. In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium until shimmering. Add the onion; cook 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft and golden.
2. Add the garlic, paprika and cumin, stir for 30 seconds, then pour in the chickpeas and broth. Bring to a simmer and cook 10 minutes, until the liquid has reduced and the chickpeas are tender.
3. Stir in the spinach and let it wilt, about 1 minute. Dot with the butter and season to taste with salt and pepper, then serve.
4. Spoon into bowls and finish each with a pinch of ground pepper.
